intro: I am interested in the Senior Data Engineer contract role with Experion Technologies in Plano. The position aligns well with my background in Python, SQL, ETL/ELT, data lake and warehouse patterns, Airflow/orchestration concepts, API-based data workflows, data modeling, query performance tuning, production pipelines, and technical mentorship.
body: At Citi, I built and supported Python, SQL, Pandas, PySpark, and AWS-oriented pipelines that ingested telemetry from more than 6,000 infrastructure endpoints and transformed raw data into curated reporting, analytics, forecasting, and validation datasets. I designed warehouse-backed reporting structures using Oracle, Redshift, AWS S3, Glue, and Athena, with strong emphasis on data quality, reconciliation, performance tuning, documentation, and production reliability.

Your role emphasizes backend data engineering, production-grade pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, APIs, REST, XML/JSON formats, ETL/ELT, Airflow, dbt, cloud-native data warehouses, strong SQL, data modeling, CI/CD practices, testing, rapid POCs, architecture/design, and mentorship. My experience maps strongly through scalable Python/SQL pipelines, PySpark/Spark processing, data quality controls, API/data integration concepts, warehouse design, performance optimization, documentation, and cross-functional technical leadership.

I want to be direct about fit: my strongest production stack is AWS, Python, SQL, PySpark, Oracle, Redshift, ETL, and production reporting reliability. Azure ADF/ADLS, Microsoft SQL Server, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, SSAS/SSRS, Power BI, Tableau, and proptech domain data are adjacent or transferable areas for me rather than long-term production ownership. Where I would bring immediate value is data pipeline delivery, SQL performance tuning, data architecture, validation, documentation, and mentoring junior engineers.
conclusion: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my senior data engineering, Python/SQL, ETL/ELT, data modeling, production pipeline, and technical mentorship background can support Experion's client work.
